name: Devour
source:
Your mom sends you off to collect some mushrooms from the local forest with the usual warning: “Be careful of Devourers!” Not that anything exciting like that could ever happen to you.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你妈妈让你去当地的森林里采集一些蘑菇，并警告你：“小心吞噬者！”并不是说任何令人兴奋的事情都会发生在你身上。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
